name: Spoken LAMAGUE (SpL) — consolidated registry
status: CONSOLIDATION — no form invented here. Every entry is transcribed from an existing document in this repository, with its source recorded.
why: SpL forms are currently scattered across at least six documents with no single machine-readable home.

README.md lists `SpL-X_Spoken_LAMAGUE_Extended_v1.0.md` in its Extensions table. That file is NOT in this repository — checked by name and by content, 2026-08-07. Neither are the other two files in the same table.
This registry is therefore a reconstruction from surviving sources, not a copy of the canonical document. If SpL-X v1.0 is recovered, it is authoritative and this file must be reconciled against it.

declared_phonotactics.claim_made_there: maps to the most common syllable structure across all human language families — 'not designed for this. It was discovered.'
declared_phonotactics.status: UNVERIFIED — no typological citation, no sample, no test. Flagged, not endorsed.

lexical_particles._status: INFERRED from glosses — these are not declared in any table found
lexical_particles.na: process / interrogative — GLOSS UNCERTAIN, used both ways in the examples

prosodic_particles._stacking_rule: after semantic particles, max 3, ordered intensity → tempo → tension → register

attested_utterances._note: Every complete SpL sentence found in the corpus. These are the only running text the language has.

17_CONTINUUM §4.4.spl: A vu-om-na li. Ni fi-om. Kas-om-na?
17_CONTINUUM §4.4.gloss: I grieve continuously. Not joy. Cascade-whole?

native36_spoken_forms._relationship_to_SpL: UNDECLARED ANYWHERE. These are a second, independently-assigned set of spoken forms for a 36-glyph alphabet. Overlap and conflict with the SpL core phonemes above is documented in SPOKEN_LAMAGUE_FINDINGS.md and has never been reconciled in any source.
